top_signals.title: Warsh Sets the Tone for Fed’s Road Ahead
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh’s first Jackson Hole speech gave central bankers and investors greater clarity on how he views the economy and the Fed’s path ahead, though questions remain about the timing and number of potential rate hikes. Bloomberg Odd Lots co-host Joe Weisenthal is on Bloomberg This Weekend to discuss the annual gathering, where monetary policy debates mix with informal conversations among some of the world’s most influential central bankers.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Chinese Solar Giant Longi Reports Deeper Net Loss in First Half
top_signals.summary: Longi Green Energy Technology Co. joined other Chinese solar producers in reporting a first-half loss that widened from a year earlier, underscoring a downturn in the sector that has lasted for more than two years.

top_signals.title: 45 Japan prefectures cite vehicle evacuee tracking issues: Survey
top_signals.summary: Local governments struggle to grasp the individual situations of such evacuees, raises concerns that they may not get the emergency assistance they need.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Realism and research underpin film with autistic protagonist
top_signals.summary: Syoutarou Kobayasi reflects on his careful approach to portraying an autistic man's experience in "Lives at Right Angles."
